_doc: ATTACK_HIGH's raise + cock, then a snap back: pull_back = joint offsets from the raised pose; jaw_after = jaw after the snap; t_back seconds.

_help.like: uses this attack's raise and cock, then snaps back
_help.pull_back.lift: shoulder offset from the raised pose for the snap back (deg; negative = pulls back/up)
_help.pull_back.wrist: wrist offset for the snap back (deg)
_help.captured.end: end pose captured from the arm (real degrees): dips forward/down with the wrist snapped up. Overrides pull_back. Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
